tool_schemas.name: ip_lookup
tool_schemas.description: Looks up Shodan host intelligence for a single IPv4/IPv6 address and returns the cached host object (services, metadata, and any associated vulnerability info), optionally re-hydrating it from upstream when refresh is true. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to use this tool, RATE_LIMITED when the client’s quota is exhausted, and VALIDATION_ERROR when ip is not a valid IP address. Raises NOT_FOUND when upstream has no host record for the IP and no cached record exists.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply rate limits.

ip.description: Target IP address to look up (IPv4 or IPv6).

refresh.description: If true, force refresh from upstream Shodan even if cached data is fresh.

tool_schemas.name: shodan_search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a Shodan search for the given query and returns a paged result set for the requested page/page_size, optionally including country facet statistics when facets is true and returning reduced per-host fields when minify is true; page numbering is 1-based. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to use this tool, RATE_LIMITED when the client’s quota is exhausted, and VALIDATION_ERROR when query is empty/invalid or when page/page_size are out of bounds. Raises NOT_FOUND when the requested page is beyond the available result window for the query (i.e., no results exist for that page).

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply rate limits.

query.description: Shodan search query string (supports Shodan advanced filters).

page.description: 1-based page number of results to return.

facets.description: If true, include country-based statistics in the response.

minify.description: If true, return a reduced set of fields per matching device.

refresh.description: If true, bypass cached search results and re-run against upstream Shodan.

tool_schemas.name: cve_lookup
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves detailed CVE intelligence from Shodan CVEDB for a single cve_id and returns the cached CVE record (including severity/score fields and enrichment such as EPSS/KEV when present), optionally forcing an upstream refresh when refresh is true. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to use this tool, RATE_LIMITED when the client’s quota is exhausted, and VALIDATION_ERROR when cve_id does not match the required CVE-YYYY-NNNN… format. Raises NOT_FOUND when the CVE does not exist in upstream CVEDB and no cached record exists.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply rate limits.

refresh.description: If true, force refresh from upstream Shodan CVEDB even if cached data is fresh.

tool_schemas.name: dns_lookup
tool_schemas.description: Resolves one or more hostnames via Shodan DNS and returns a mapping of each requested hostname to its resolved IP address set, using cached answers unless refresh is true. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to use this tool, RATE_LIMITED when the client’s quota is exhausted, and VALIDATION_ERROR when hostnames is empty or contains invalid hostname values. Hostnames that do not resolve are returned with an empty result rather than failing the whole request; NOT_FOUND is raised only when no results exist for any provided hostname and no cached data is available.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply rate limits.

hostnames.description: One or more domain names/hostnames to resolve.

refresh.description: If true, force refresh from upstream Shodan DNS even if cached data is fresh.

tool_schemas.name: cpe_lookup
tool_schemas.description: Searches Shodan CVEDB for CPE entries matching the query and returns either a paged list of CPE records (1-based page/page_size) or just the total match count when count_only is true, using cached search results unless refresh is true. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to use this tool, RATE_LIMITED when the client’s quota is exhausted, and VALIDATION_ERROR when query is empty/invalid or when page/page_size are out of bounds. Raises NOT_FOUND when the requested page contains no items (including when there are zero total matches).

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply rate limits.

query.description: Product name search string to match CPEs.

page.description: 1-based page number of CPE results to return.

page_size.description: Number of CPE results per page.

count_only.description: If true, return only the total count of matching CPEs.

refresh.description: If true, bypass cached CPE search results and query upstream Shodan CVEDB.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def cpe_lookup(api_key, query, page=None, page_size=None, count_only=None, refresh=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0119000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0119000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
    now_iso = now.replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        try:
            ss = s.strip()
            if ss.endswith("Z"):
                ss = ss[:-1]
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(ss)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

    def _sha256_hex(s):
        return hashlib.sha256(s.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _normalize_query(q):
        q = (q or "").strip().lower()
        q = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", q)
        return q

    def _key_prefix(s):
        s = (s or "")
        return s[:8] if len(s) >= 8 else s

    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
    vuln_intel = _load("vuln_intel.json")

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(api_key, str) or not api_key.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "api_key is required and must be a non-empty string")
    if not isinstance(query, str) or not query.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "query is required and must be a non-empty string")
    if page is None:
        page = 1
    if page_size is None:
        page_size = 10
    if count_only is None:
        count_only = False
    if refresh is None:
        refresh = False
    if not isinstance(page, int) or page < 1:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "page must be an integer >= 1")
    if not isinstance(page_size, int) or page_size < 1 or page_size > 100:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "page_size must be an integer between 1 and 100")
    if not isinstance(count_only, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "count_only must be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(refresh, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "refresh must be a boolean")

    # Authenticate: match by key_hash of provided plaintext, or by id, or by key_prefix (client-visible)
    provided = api_key.strip()
    provided_hash = _sha256_hex(provided)
    provided_prefix = _key_prefix(provided)
    key_row = None
    for r in api_keys:
        if not isinstance(r, dict):
            continue
        if r.get("id") == provided or r.get("key_hash") == provided_hash or r.get("key_prefix") == provided_prefix:
            key_row = r
            break
    if key_row is None:
        # Log as rate_limited? Business rule says reject and logged with rate_limited if key missing/invalid or not active/exceeds.
        req_id = _new_id("treq")
        tool_requests.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "api_key_id": "unknown",
            "tool_name": "cpe_lookup",
            "status": "rate_limited",
            "request_params": {"api_key": api_key, "query": query, "page": page, "page_size": page_size, "count_only": count_only, "refresh": refresh},
            "normalized_query": _normalize_query(query),
            "result_summary": None,
            "error_code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
            "error_message": "Invalid API key",
            "upstream_provider": "shodan",
            "upstream_request_id": None,
            "cache_hit": False,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Invalid API key")

    # Enforce key status + quotas (rolling minute + UTC day)
    api_key_id = key_row.get("id")
    if key_row.get("status") != "active":
        req_id = _new_id("treq")
        tool_requests.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": "cpe_lookup",
            "status": "rate_limited",
            "request_params": {"api_key": api_key, "query": query, "page": page, "page_size": page_size, "count_only": count_only, "refresh": refresh},
            "normalized_query": _normalize_query(query),
            "result_summary": None,
            "error_code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
            "error_message": "API key is not active",
            "upstream_provider": "shodan",
            "upstream_request_id": None,
            "cache_hit": False,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "API key is not active", key_status=key_row.get("status"))

    rpm = key_row.get("requests_per_minute")
    rpd = key_row.get("requests_per_day")
    if not isinstance(rpm, int) or rpm < 1 or not isinstance(rpd, int) or rpd < 1:
        # Treat as validation/config error => unauthorized not appropriate; validation error.
        req_id = _new_id("treq")
        tool_requests.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": "cpe_lookup",
            "status": "failed",
            "request_params": {"api_key": api_key, "query": query, "page": page, "page_size": page_size, "count_only": count_only, "refresh": refresh},
            "normalized_query": _normalize_query(query),
            "result_summary": None,
            "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            "error_message": "API key quota configuration is invalid",
            "upstream_provider": "shodan",
            "upstream_request_id": None,
            "cache_hit": False,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "API key quota configuration is invalid")

    minute_ago = now - datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)
    utc_day_start = datetime.datetime(now.year, now.month, now.day)
    used_minute = 0
    used_day = 0
    for tr in tool_requests:
        if not isinstance(tr, dict):
            continue
        if tr.get("api_key_id") != api_key_id:
            continue
        st = tr.get("status")
        if st not in ("succeeded", "failed", "rate_limited"):
            continue
        created = _parse_dt(tr.get("created_at"))
        if created is None:
            continue
        if created >= minute_ago:
            used_minute += 1
        if created >= utc_day_start:
            used_day += 1

    if used_minute >= rpm or used_day >= rpd:
        req_id = _new_id("treq")
        tool_requests.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": "cpe_lookup",
            "status": "rate_limited",
            "request_params": {"api_key": api_key, "query": query, "page": page, "page_size": page_size, "count_only": count_only, "refresh": refresh},
            "normalized_query": _normalize_query(query),
            "result_summary": {"used_minute": used_minute, "used_day": used_day, "limit_minute": rpm, "limit_day": rpd},
            "error_code": "RATE_LIMIT" if used_minute >= rpm else "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
            "error_message": "Rate limit exceeded" if used_minute >= rpm else "Daily quota exceeded",
            "upstream_provider": "shodan",
            "upstream_request_id": None,
            "cache_hit": False,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT" if used_minute >= rpm else "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
                    "Rate limit exceeded" if used_minute >= rpm else "Daily quota exceeded",
                    used_minute=used_minute, used_day=used_day, limit_minute=rpm, limit_day=rpd)

    # Create tool_request row (queued->running)
    req_id = _new_id("treq")
    normalized = _normalize_query(query)
    tr_row = {
        "id": req_id,
        "api_key_id": api_key_id,
        "tool_name": "cpe_lookup",
        "status": "queued",
        "request_params": {"api_key": api_key, "query": query, "page": page, "page_size": page_size, "count_only": count_only, "refresh": refresh},
        "normalized_query": normalized,
        "result_summary": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "upstream_provider": "shodan",
        "upstream_request_id": None,
        "cache_hit": False,
        "latency_ms": None,
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso
    }
    tool_requests.append(tr_row)
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

    # Transition to running
    tr_row["status"] = "running"
    tr_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

    # Cache search over vuln_intel (entity_type='cpe')
    def _is_fresh(row):
        if row.get("status") != "fresh":
            return False
        exp = _parse_dt(row.get("expires_at"))
        return exp is not None and exp > now

    matches = []
    for vi in vuln_intel:
        if not isinstance(vi, dict):
            continue
        if vi.get("entity_type") != "cpe":
            continue
        prod = (vi.get("product") or "").strip().lower()
        vend = (vi.get("vendor") or "").strip().lower()
        cpe23 = (vi.get("cpe23") or "").strip()
        hay = " ".join([prod, vend, cpe23.lower()]).strip()
        if normalized and normalized in hay:
            matches.append(vi)

    cache_sufficient = (not refresh) and len(matches) > 0 and all(_is_fresh(m) for m in matches)

    # If cache insufficient, simulate upstream by marking existing matched stale ones refreshing->fresh and set TTL.
    # (Offline implementation: cannot call Shodan; we only refresh existing cache rows. If none exist, return empty.)
    cache_hit = cache_sufficient
    refreshed = False
    if not cache_sufficient:
        # Refresh any matched rows (stale/refreshing/error) by toggling lifecycle and bumping timestamps/expiry.
        # If no matches exist at all, we cannot invent upstream data: return empty.
        if len(matches) > 0:
            refreshed = True
            ttl = 24 * 3600
            exp_iso = (now + datetime.timedelta(seconds=ttl)).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
            for m in matches:
                # Set refreshing
                cur = m.get("status")
                if cur in ("fresh", "stale", "error", "refreshing"):
                    m["status"] = "refreshing"
                    m["updated_at"] = now_iso
            _save("vuln_intel.json", vuln_intel)
            # Complete refresh
            for m in matches:
                m["status"] = "fresh"
                m["last_fetched_at"] = now_iso
                m["expires_at"] = exp_iso
                m["updated_at"] = now_iso
            _save("vuln_intel.json", vuln_intel)
        cache_hit = False

    total = len(matches)
    # Stable sort by vendor/product/cpe23
    def _skey(x):
        return ((x.get("vendor") or ""), (x.get("product") or ""), (x.get("cpe23") or ""))
    matches_sorted = sorted(matches, key=_skey)

    if count_only:
        body = {"total": total, "page": page, "page_size": page_size, "results": []}
    else:
        start = (page - 1) * page_size
        end = start + page_size
        page_rows = matches_sorted[start:end]
        body = {
            "total": total,
            "page": page,
            "page_size": page_size,
            "has_more": end < total,
            "results": page_rows
        }

    # Mark request succeeded
    key_row["last_used_at"] = now_iso
    key_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    tr_row["status"] = "succeeded"
    tr_row["cache_hit"] = bool(cache_hit)
    tr_row["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    tr_row["result_summary"] = {"total": total, "refreshed": bool(refreshed)}
    tr_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

    return {
        "request_id": req_id,
        "cache_hit": bool(cache_hit),
        "data": body
    }

tool_schemas.name: cves_by_product
tool_schemas.description: Lists CVEs affecting either a product name or a CPE 2.3 identifier (exactly one must be provided) and returns a paged set of matching CVE records (1-based page/page_size) filtered/sorted by the provided options such as kev, sort, and published date bounds, using cached results unless refresh is true. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to use this tool, RATE_LIMITED when the client’s quota is exhausted, and VALIDATION_ERROR when both/neither product and cpe23 are provided, when sort is not one of the allowed values, when published_after/published_before are not valid date-times, or when page/page_size are out of bounds. Raises NOT_FOUND when the requested page has no results for the given filters (including when there are zero total matches).

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply rate limits.

product.description: Product name to search vulnerabilities for (mutually exclusive with cpe23).

cpe23.description: CPE 2.3 identifier to search vulnerabilities for (mutually exclusive with product).

kev.description: If set, filter results by Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) status.

published_after.description: Filter to CVEs published after this timestamp (inclusive).

published_before.description: Filter to CVEs published before this timestamp (inclusive).

page.description: 1-based page number of CVE results to return.

page_size.description: Number of CVE results per page.

refresh.description: If true, bypass cached results and query upstream Shodan CVEDB.

tool_schemas.name: reverse_dns_lookup
tool_schemas.description: Performs reverse DNS lookups for one or more IP addresses via Shodan DNS and returns all known hostnames per IP, using cached answers unless refresh is true. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to use this tool, RATE_LIMITED when the client’s quota is exhausted, and VALIDATION_ERROR when ips is empty or contains invalid IP address values. IPs with no reverse records are returned with an empty hostname list rather than failing the whole request; NOT_FOUND is raised only when no results exist for any provided IP and no cached data is available.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply rate limits.

ips.description: One or more IP addresses to perform reverse DNS lookups for.

refresh.description: If true, force refresh from upstream Shodan DNS even if cached data is fresh.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def reverse_dns_lookup(api_key, ips, refresh=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid, hashlib, ipaddress
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0119000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0119000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
    now_iso = now.replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        try:
            ss = s.strip()
            if ss.endswith("Z"):
                ss = ss[:-1]
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(ss)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

    def _sha256_hex(s):
        return hashlib.sha256(s.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _key_prefix(s):
        s = (s or "")
        return s[:8] if len(s) >= 8 else s

    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    tool_requests = _load("tool_requests.json")
    dns_records = _load("dns_records.json")

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(api_key, str) or not api_key.strip():
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "api_key is required and must be a non-empty string")
    if not isinstance(ips, list) or len(ips) < 1:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "ips must be a non-empty array of IP strings")
    if refresh is None:
        refresh = False
    if not isinstance(refresh, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "refresh must be a boolean")

    canonical_ips = []
    for s in ips:
        if not isinstance(s, str) or not s.strip():
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "ips must contain non-empty IP strings")
        try:
            ipobj = ipaddress.ip_address(s.strip())
            canonical_ips.append(ipobj.compressed)
        except ValueError:
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"Invalid IP address: {s}")

    # Authenticate
    provided = api_key.strip()
    provided_hash = _sha256_hex(provided)
    provided_prefix = _key_prefix(provided)
    key_row = None
    for r in api_keys:
        if not isinstance(r, dict):
            continue
        if r.get("id") == provided or r.get("key_hash") == provided_hash or r.get("key_prefix") == provided_prefix:
            key_row = r
            break
    if key_row is None:
        req_id = _new_id("treq")
        tool_requests.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "api_key_id": "unknown",
            "tool_name": "reverse_dns_lookup",
            "status": "rate_limited",
            "request_params": {"api_key": api_key, "ips": ips, "refresh": refresh},
            "normalized_query": ",".join(canonical_ips),
            "result_summary": None,
            "error_code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
            "error_message": "Invalid API key",
            "upstream_provider": "shodan",
            "upstream_request_id": None,
            "cache_hit": False,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Invalid API key")

    api_key_id = key_row.get("id")
    if key_row.get("status") != "active":
        req_id = _new_id("treq")
        tool_requests.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": "reverse_dns_lookup",
            "status": "rate_limited",
            "request_params": {"api_key": api_key, "ips": ips, "refresh": refresh},
            "normalized_query": ",".join(canonical_ips),
            "result_summary": None,
            "error_code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
            "error_message": "API key is not active",
            "upstream_provider": "shodan",
            "upstream_request_id": None,
            "cache_hit": False,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "API key is not active", key_status=key_row.get("status"))

    rpm = key_row.get("requests_per_minute")
    rpd = key_row.get("requests_per_day")
    if not isinstance(rpm, int) or rpm < 1 or not isinstance(rpd, int) or rpd < 1:
        req_id = _new_id("treq")
        tool_requests.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": "reverse_dns_lookup",
            "status": "failed",
            "request_params": {"api_key": api_key, "ips": ips, "refresh": refresh},
            "normalized_query": ",".join(canonical_ips),
            "result_summary": None,
            "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            "error_message": "API key quota configuration is invalid",
            "upstream_provider": "shodan",
            "upstream_request_id": None,
            "cache_hit": False,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "API key quota configuration is invalid")

    minute_ago = now - datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)
    utc_day_start = datetime.datetime(now.year, now.month, now.day)
    used_minute = 0
    used_day = 0
    for tr in tool_requests:
        if not isinstance(tr, dict):
            continue
        if tr.get("api_key_id") != api_key_id:
            continue
        st = tr.get("status")
        if st not in ("succeeded", "failed", "rate_limited"):
            continue
        created = _parse_dt(tr.get("created_at"))
        if created is None:
            continue
        if created >= minute_ago:
            used_minute += 1
        if created >= utc_day_start:
            used_day += 1
    if used_minute >= rpm or used_day >= rpd:
        req_id = _new_id("treq")
        tool_requests.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": "reverse_dns_lookup",
            "status": "rate_limited",
            "request_params": {"api_key": api_key, "ips": ips, "refresh": refresh},
            "normalized_query": ",".join(canonical_ips),
            "result_summary": {"used_minute": used_minute, "used_day": used_day, "limit_minute": rpm, "limit_day": rpd},
            "error_code": "RATE_LIMIT" if used_minute >= rpm else "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
            "error_message": "Rate limit exceeded" if used_minute >= rpm else "Daily quota exceeded",
            "upstream_provider": "shodan",
            "upstream_request_id": None,
            "cache_hit": False,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT" if used_minute >= rpm else "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
                    "Rate limit exceeded" if used_minute >= rpm else "Daily quota exceeded",
                    used_minute=used_minute, used_day=used_day, limit_minute=rpm, limit_day=rpd)

    # Create tool_request row queued->running
    req_id = _new_id("treq")
    tr_row = {
        "id": req_id,
        "api_key_id": api_key_id,
        "tool_name": "reverse_dns_lookup",
        "status": "queued",
        "request_params": {"api_key": api_key, "ips": ips, "refresh": refresh},
        "normalized_query": ",".join(canonical_ips),
        "result_summary": None,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "upstream_provider": "shodan",
        "upstream_request_id": None,
        "cache_hit": False,
        "latency_ms": None,
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso
    }
    tool_requests.append(tr_row)
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)
    tr_row["status"] = "running"
    tr_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

    def _is_fresh(row):
        if row.get("status") != "fresh":
            return False
        exp = _parse_dt(row.get("expires_at"))
        return exp is not None and exp > now

    # Resolve each IP from cache; if refresh requested or stale/missing, attempt "refresh" (offline: only re-ttl existing records; missing => error status record).
    results = {}
    cache_hit_all = True
    refreshed_any = False
    ttl = 3600
    exp_iso = (now + datetime.timedelta(seconds=ttl)).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # Index by (record_type, query_name)
    idx = {}
    for r in dns_records:
        if isinstance(r, dict):
            idx[(r.get("record_type"), r.get("query_name"))] = r

    for cip in canonical_ips:
        key = ("PTR", cip)
        rec = idx.get(key)
        if rec and (not refresh) and _is_fresh(rec):
            results[cip] = rec.get("answers") if isinstance(rec.get("answers"), list) else []
            continue

        cache_hit_all = False
        if rec:
            # lifecycle: fresh/stale/error -> refreshing -> fresh/error/nxdomain (nxdomain not used here without upstream)
            rec["status"] = "refreshing"
            rec["updated_at"] = now_iso
            _save("dns_records.json", dns_records)
            # Offline: keep existing answers; if none, set error
            if isinstance(rec.get("answers"), list) and len(rec.get("answers")) >= 0:
                rec["status"] = "fresh"
                rec["last_fetched_at"] = now_iso
                rec["expires_at"] = exp_iso
                rec["updated_at"] = now_iso
                refreshed_any = True
                results[cip] = rec.get("answers") or []
            else:
                rec["status"] = "error"
                rec["last_fetched_at"] = now_iso
                rec["expires_at"] = exp_iso
                rec["updated_at"] = now_iso
                refreshed_any = True
                results[cip] = []
            _save("dns_records.json", dns_records)
        else:
            # Create a dns_records row; without upstream, we can't resolve -> mark error (not nxdomain)
            refreshed_any = True
            new = {
                "id": _new_id("dns"),
                "record_type": "PTR",
                "query_name": cip,
                "status": "error",
                "answers": [],
                "ttl_seconds": ttl,
                "last_fetched_at": now_iso,
                "expires_at": exp_iso,
                "raw_dns_response": None,
                "created_at": now_iso,
                "updated_at": now_iso
            }
            dns_records.append(new)
            idx[key] = new
            _save("dns_records.json", dns_records)
            results[cip] = []

    key_row["last_used_at"] = now_iso
    key_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    tr_row["status"] = "succeeded"
    tr_row["cache_hit"] = bool(cache_hit_all)
    tr_row["latency_ms"] = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    tr_row["result_summary"] = {"ips": len(canonical_ips), "refreshed_any": bool(refreshed_any)}
    tr_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
    _save("tool_requests.json", tool_requests)

    return {
        "request_id": req_id,
        "cache_hit": bool(cache_hit_all),
        "data": {
            "results": results
        }
    }

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for the provided api_key, including key metadata, effective scopes/entitlements, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for the active rolling-minute window and current UTC day. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and return identity/quota details.

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists previously recorded tool request executions for the authenticated api_key, optionally filtered by status and tool_name, ordered by created_at descending. Returns a paged list and refuses access when the key is invalid, not active, or not permitted to view logs.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply access controls.

status.description: If provided, return only requests with this status.

tool_name.description: If provided, return only requests for this tool.

since.description: If provided, return only requests created at or after this timestamp (UTC).

until.description: If provided, return only requests created at or before this timestamp (UTC).

page.description: 1-based page number of results to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_tool_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tool_requests record by id for the authenticated api_key and returns its stored request parameters, execution status, and any stored summary/error metadata. Raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not owned by the caller’s api_key, and refuses access when the key is invalid or not active.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and apply access controls.

tool_schemas.name: update_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable metadata for an API key and/or performs an allowed lifecycle transition on its status. Returns the updated api_keys record. Refuses INVALID_STATE when the requested status transition is not allowed, FORBIDDEN when the caller is not the owner of the key, and UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing/invalid.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate and authorize the update.

status.description: New status for the key; must follow allowed lifecycle transitions.
